intro: Three tones, one calming whole. Upmods Trio’s colour-blocked headboard and soft finish bring visual balance and deep storage below hide the mess without hiding the style.

features.title: Design that strikes a visual rhythm
features.text: With its triple-toned headboard, Trio brings depth and interest without overwhelming—adding just enough personality to feel bespoke.

features.title: Built to last, not just to look
features.text: The engineered wood base delivers everyday strength with a lightweight look—built for all the flops, turns, and stretches.

features.title: Lift to clear the clutter
features.text: The smooth lift-up mechanism makes it effortless to access spacious storage underneath—perfect for duvets, winterwear, or your favourite extras. Available in multiple storage options, so you can choose what works best for your home and lifestyle.

features.title: Matte wood finish, maximum calm
features.text: Our soft matte wood surface adds warmth and ease, blending into bedrooms without demanding attention.

features.title: We made space for your favourites
features.text: Our built-in display ledge lets you keep your essentials—like décor, books, or bedtime tech—right within reach, so your space stays organised without ever feeling cluttered.

name: Upmods Trio King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
